what: On a pale curtain the logo floats up from .8x with a .8s back.out(1.7), and a spiral panel holding six rings of circular text (1, 1.35, 1.7, 2.05, 2.4, 2.75x, staggered by 60° each) grows from 0 → 4x over 5s sine.out starting at .3s while turning 60° — the outer the ring, the faster it blurs out to 8px (3, 3, 5, 8, 10s), and the innermost ring fades to .4 at 2s. At the same time the clouds (screen blend) rise from .5 opacity and 2x, and the island map rises from 3px blur→0, .2 opacity, 2x and -9° over 3s. From 2.3s a circular hole in the center opens to the screen edge over 1.2s power2.out, at 1.3s fx:cue (turns on the hero’s big title), at 3s the scroll is released with fx:open, and at 3.5s the curtain is removed with fx:done.

options.text: Ring text (printed in English capitals), default “PLACE YOUR TAGLINE AROUND THE RING · ” — spread evenly around the ring
options.repeat: How many times the text repeats per ring revolution, default 1
options.rings: Number of rings (child [data-fx-part=ring] is absent, the part creates it), default 6
options.scale-step · angle-step: Scale growth per ring and staggered angle, default .35 · 60
options.grow · turn · dur · ease: Spiral board end multiplier·rotation (°)·duration·curve, default 4 · 60 · 5 · sine.out
options.logo · logo-ease: Logo rise duration and curve, default .8 · back.out(1.7)
options.hole · hole-ease · hole-at: Hole opening length and curve, how many seconds before the spiral ends it starts — default 1.2 · power2.out · 3
options.cue: Fires fx:cue some seconds before the spiral ends, default 4 (lights up the Hero title letters)
options.unlock · hide: Seconds for scroll release (fx:open) and wipe (fx:done), default 3 · 3.5 — in the original a separate setTimeout from the timeline
options.speed: Global speed multiplier (timeScale), default 1 — screens opened often use 2 to 3 to shorten it
options.lock: If off, scroll is not locked
options.--fx-size: Size of one ring (via style), default min(30vw, 430px) — original 43rem (phone 30rem)
options.[data-fx-part]: spiral (spiral plate, created if missing) > ring (the ring, created if missing) · logo · cloud · map (optional, with svg·img inside)

from.where: index.html .cp-loader — original fv.js loading timeline (logo .8 back.out(1.7) → spiral 5s sine.out -=.5 → cloud·rettou 3s < → --mask-size 1.2s power2.out -=3 → call -=4) and fv.css .spiral-item six ring layers·spiralBlur·spiralOpacity

note: The hole pushes the transparent range of a radial-gradient(circle) mask from 0 → 100% (no edge blur). The ring text is spread evenly along the circumference (2π·236) with SVG textPath.
